title: A17+A21: strategy.* trade statistics vars and capital_held
acceptance_criteria: strategy.avg_trade returns average profit/loss per trade
strategy.avg_trade_percent returns average percentage gain/loss per trade
strategy.avg_winning_trade returns average profit per winning trade
strategy.avg_winning_trade_percent returns average % gain per winning trade
strategy.avg_losing_trade returns average loss per losing trade
strategy.avg_losing_trade_percent returns average % loss per losing trade
strategy.opentrades.capital_held returns capital held by open trades
